message: I have a final tomorrow and I'm so anxious I'm shaking. I can't focus. I'm going to fail and lose my scholarship. Please help me calm down.

message: I have a huge work presentation tomorrow and I'm not ready. I've been procrastinating because I'm terrified of public speaking. I'm panicking. Help.
